Tap the shield just before a bullet hits the front of your ship. The parry window is 100 ms. A perfect parry absorbs nearby bullets and has no cooldown. A missed parry starts a 3-second cooldown. Release, then press again for each attempt. The shield cannot block enemy contact or beams.

Dash through danger. Nova damages nearby enemies and clears their bullets. Gamepad: use both sticks to play. Use the D-pad to choose an upgrade, then press A.
